Assume AC and use the intrinsic rational Borel–Moore grading of [[def-intrinsic-quotient-stack-borel-moore-grading]]. For any finite quiver over $\mathbb C$, the representation, extension and finite block-flag stacks admit the following operations: representable proper invariant-flag-forgetting maps have degree-zero proper pushforward; diagonal-block-forgetting maps have smooth pullback of degree twice their relative stack dimension. For the exact-sequence map $q$ this degree is $2(e-u)=-2\chi_Q(\mathbf b,\mathbf a)$, where $e=\sum_{h:i\to j}b_i a_j$ and $u=\sum_i a_i b_i$.

[F1] [[lem-quiver-exact-sequence-correspondence-is-smooth-and-proper]]: the upper arrow locus has free off-diagonal rank $e$, the parabolic is $U\rtimes L$ with $\dim U=u$, and invariant-flag forgetting is representable proper. The proof constructs its relative closed incidence schemes and includes all rank-zero and loop cases.

[F2] [[def-intrinsic-quotient-stack-borel-moore-grading]] and [[lem-quiver-parabolic-levi-borel-model-comparisons]]: the intrinsic index, actual induced varieties, natural degree-preserving Levi/total-GL frame comparison and coherent product models. These give a proved interface for the change of presentation used below.
